case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our work together and want to find a solution that suits both sides.

Our data shows a different picture on one point:

Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we would like to propose two options:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 358.66; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 356.28; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option A answers your cost side through longer payment terms, while Option B keeps your current payment terms. Both are laid out so they can go straight to your pricing committee. If it needs any further material from us for its approval, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your response and for sharing the quality data. While we continuously strive for zero defects, the cited ppm level remains within acceptable tolerances and does not offset the substantial material cost increases we face.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer stands at a price of €372.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we can offer a revised price of €370.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms.

Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.
